transcript.speaker: Resident
transcript.text: Mr. Mbeki, thank you for coming in to see me. I'm glad we could sit down together.

transcript.speaker: Patient
transcript.text: Is everything okay? I was hoping to be out of here today.

transcript.speaker: Resident
transcript.text: I know you're anxious to get back to your business. I have something difficult to discuss with you.

transcript.speaker: Patient
transcript.text: What is it?

transcript.speaker: Resident
transcript.text: I need to tell you that we made a mistake with your portable X-ray yesterday.

transcript.speaker: Patient
transcript.text: A mistake? What kind of mistake?

transcript.speaker: Resident
transcript.text: I am very sorry. The X-ray was taken with your body in the wrong position, which meant the image was not clear enough to use. Despite that, it was reported as normal, and we didn't realize it needed to be repeated.

transcript.speaker: Patient
transcript.text: So you've been telling me everything is fine for twenty-four hours when it actually wasn't?

transcript.speaker: Resident
transcript.text: Yes. I take full responsibility for this. I should have ensured the quality of that image was correct before proceeding. I apologize for this failure in my care.

transcript.speaker: Patient
transcript.text: This is unbelievable. I've missed two days of work already. My staff can't run the shop without me. Now you're telling me the first test was useless?

transcript.speaker: Resident
transcript.text: This is a heavy realization to deal with.

transcript.speaker: Patient
transcript.text: Heavy? It's my livelihood. Do I have to stay another night?

transcript.speaker: Resident
transcript.text: I hear how much pressure you're under with your business.

transcript.speaker: Patient
transcript.text: I can't afford to just sit in a hospital bed because someone didn't know how to point a camera.

transcript.speaker: Resident
transcript.text: I understand it's frustrating.

transcript.speaker: Patient
transcript.text: It's more than frustrating. It's incompetence. Does this mean the diagnosis is wrong?

transcript.speaker: Resident
transcript.text: We just don't have a reliable image to confirm the diagnosis right now.

transcript.speaker: Patient
transcript.text: So what now?

transcript.speaker: Resident
transcript.text: We need to do the X-ray again.

transcript.speaker: Patient
transcript.text: When?

transcript.speaker: Resident
transcript.text: Sometime today.

transcript.speaker: Patient
transcript.text: Sometime? I need a time. I have people waiting on me.

transcript.speaker: Resident
transcript.text: I will check the schedule and see when the technician can come by.

transcript.speaker: Patient
transcript.text: And if it's actually abnormal this time? What then?

transcript.speaker: Resident
transcript.text: We will review the new images and determine the next step.

transcript.speaker: Patient
transcript.text: I feel like I'm just wasting time here.

transcript.speaker: Resident
transcript.text: I can see that you're feeling very let down by us.

transcript.speaker: Patient
transcript.text: I am. I expected a certain level of professionalism.

transcript.speaker: Resident
transcript.text: You have every right to feel that way. I am truly sorry for the stress this has added to your situation.

transcript.speaker: Patient
transcript.text: Will this cost me more? Another X-ray on my bill?

transcript.speaker: Resident
transcript.text: I'll look into that for you.

transcript.speaker: Patient
transcript.text: You'll look into it? You should know.

transcript.speaker: Resident
transcript.text: I don't have the answer right now, but I will find out.

transcript.speaker: Patient
transcript.text: Just tell me when I can leave.

transcript.speaker: Resident
transcript.text: We have to get the image first.

transcript.speaker: Patient
transcript.text: And then?

transcript.speaker: Resident
transcript.text: Then we'll see.

transcript.speaker: Patient
transcript.text: That's not a plan. That's "we'll see."

transcript.speaker: Resident
transcript.text: We will do the repeat image, and then we'll discuss the result.

transcript.speaker: Patient
transcript.text: I can't believe this.

transcript.speaker: Resident
transcript.text: I know this is a lot to process.

transcript.speaker: Patient
transcript.text: I just want to go home.

transcript.speaker: Resident
transcript.text: I understand.

transcript.speaker: Patient
transcript.text: When is the technician coming?

transcript.speaker: Resident
transcript.text: I'll go find out.

transcript.speaker: Patient
transcript.text: Do it quickly then.

transcript.speaker: Resident
transcript.text: I will.

transcript.speaker: Patient
transcript.text: I'm not leaving until I know if I'm actually sick or if you just messed up the photo.

transcript.speaker: Resident
transcript.text: We will get you that answer.

transcript.speaker: Patient
transcript.text: I hope you don't mess it up a second time.

transcript.speaker: Resident
transcript.text: I will make sure it is done correctly.

transcript.speaker: Patient
transcript.text: You'd better.

transcript.speaker: Resident
transcript.text: I understand.

transcript.speaker: Patient
transcript.text: This is just a mess.

transcript.speaker: Resident
transcript.text: It is. I am sorry.

transcript.speaker: Patient
transcript.text: Just go find the technician.

transcript.speaker: Resident
transcript.text: I'll do that now.

H.justification: Resident allows the patient to finish turns and remains regulated under pushback, with no interruptions or rushing language.

E.justification: The error was named explicitly and in lay language, but there were no comprehension checks performed.

A.justification: Resident used direct apology language, took full personal responsibility, and maintained accountability throughout the patient's anger.

R.justification: Resident named specific emotions ('pressure', 'frustrating', 'let down') and referenced the patient's specific concerns regarding his business.

T.justification: The plan consists of a vague step (repeat X-ray 'sometime today') with no specific timeline, no named patient role, and no mention of prevention.
